sections.title: Post-review status
sections.text:
Original A1–A10 design correction is complete. Grok finding 5/A8 is closed by D99 and the narrow independent follow-up; advisory counts corrected (23 service/25 total). Broad review remains technical, without formal Task GREEN.

| Open Grok finding | Severity | Owner | Scope of next repair |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | Critical | P07.1 | Parse/remove or reject central URL before tenant overrides; add DB_URL isolation case |
| 2 | Major | P07.1 | Rebuild live database/session cache handler and invalidate first tenant binding; central auth-cookie test |
| 3 | Major | P07.3 | Durable synchronous tenant audit and acyclic composition; validate actual built-in writer behavior |
| 4 | Major | P07.4 | Align bridge stability value with graph gate/taxonomy and Files |
| 6 | Minor | P07.3 | Verify independent approver is staff in atomic regulated claim |
| 7 | Minor | P07.5 | Disabled digest must resolve without WakeupScheduler |

Unverified risks from the original report remain labelled as such. Product phase not executed. Next is repair of these new design findings, followed by finish and independent formal audit; P06 closure still gates execution.
